# AI Image Journey

> A technical blog exploring AI image generation, covering Stable Diffusion, Flux, Krea, HiDream, Qwen-Image, Z-Image, and the ComfyUI ecosystem.

Written by Easygoing. Focus areas: local AI image generation models (checkpoints, licenses, color/VAE precision comparisons), ComfyUI workflows and custom nodes (ComfyUI-easygoing-nodes), Linux setup for AI workloads (Pop!_OS), and practical image-editing tooling (inpainting, upscaling, background removal).
